comment: Curated registry of unofficial cores installable on the MiSTer via the custom Downloader database (db/db.json.zip). THIS FILE IS THE APPROVAL GATE: build_unofficial_db.py only reads what is merged here. The weekly scan proposes additions by PR; review each entry, delete what you do not want installed, and merge. Fields: repo (owner/name), arcade (true = .mra territory, installs under _Unofficial Cores/_Arcade), extras (auxiliary assets from the same release, each {asset, dest}; dest is confined to games/ and _Unofficial Cores/), manual (steps deliberately left to a human, printed on every build), notes, added.

cores.notes: A behavior-based recreation of Nintendo's Monkey Magic

cores.manual: Requires the patched /media/fat/MiSTer binary shipped in the same release (it replaces the main menu executable for the WHOLE machine, so it stays a deliberate manual step) plus .vhd disk images in games/Z386/. Also needs an SDRAM module.
